context:
Goal: merges stop waiting on a running batch run.
Problem (goal): two fixes aim at the same lock; #3049 deletes it outright.
Based on (ruling): R42 part 2 (owner 13:39 CST Nov 11) and drain-first-hold part 4 (merge-flow fixes go express).
Based on (measured): the last 20 batch merges had main move under them 0 times, since the lock forbids it, so how often a merge would miss a batch's files cannot be read from history.
Departs from: main, where nothing merges while a batch runs — #3049 removes that lock, and the new lane lands only the lost design doc.

options.gain: No second fix to a lock that #3049 removes.
options.how: #3049 (lane merge-flow-after-anthropic) deletes the batch lock code and goes express. The new lane lands only the lost design doc as a prose PR, then waits.
options.label: Hold it behind #3049 (coordinator's pick)
options.lose: Merges still wait for a running batch until #3049 lands.

options.how: The lane builds the check that lets a merge land under a running batch when no file overlaps, ahead of #3049.
options.label: Build the file-disjoint merge now
options.lose: Work that #3049 throws away, and its benefit cannot be measured from history: in the last 20 batch merges main never moved under a batch.

reply: Closed 11:16 CST Nov 13 by triage: you accepted a at 11:13 CST. merge-under-running-batch holds behind #3049; its lane lands only the lost design doc. Undo: reopen this item.
title: Hold the merge-under-a-running-batch fix behind #3049, which removes the lock?
why: The coordinator took this pick; it stands unless you choose b.
